description: Returns one page of individual incidents in a city, filtered by crime type, location type, dates, text, and an optional lat/lon box. Supports limit/offset pagination. A window longer than 45 days needs a geographic filter: the box, place, or location_descriptions. Chicago's portal withholds about the last seven days. New York publishes complaints after a quarter closes.

end_date.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the newest incident.

limit.description: Maximum incidents on this page. Defaults to 25.

location_descriptions.description: Location types to include, such as STREET or RESIDENCE. Defaults to all.

offset.description: Number of incidents to skip. Defaults to 0. pagination.next_offset in the result is the next page, or null when there are no more.

place.description: Address text, such as a street name, matched against location, block, and community area. Neighborhood boundaries come from the lat/lon box.

primary_types.description: Crime types to include, such as THEFT or BATTERY. Defaults to all types.

search_text.description: Text matched against crime type and description.

start_date.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days before the newest incident.

name: get_city_crimes
title: City incidents
